# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest 2.x release of `react-brackets`, `@react-brackets/core` and `@react-brackets/theme` gets security fixes. The 0.x line is no longer maintained.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report it privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MohOulabi/react-brackets/security/advisories/new), not in a public issue.

Include what's affected, the steps to reproduce it, and the impact you see. You'll get a reply within a week. Once a fix is released, the advisory is published with credit to you, unless you'd rather stay anonymous.
